name: Strategy002: RSI<30 + Stoch<20 + below lower Bollinger + hammer (mean reversion)
one_line: Oversold confluence (RSI, slow stochastic, close under 2-sigma lower band, hammer) -> long; exit SAR above price and Fisher RSI > 0.3.

source.license: GPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE). Only ideas are summarised here; no code copied.

idea: Buy extreme short-term oversold with candle-pattern confirmation; exit when parabolic SAR flips above price and Fisher-transformed RSI recovers.

rules.name: below_lower_band
rules.description: close < Bollinger(20,2) lower band on typical price

evidence: No published results in the repo.
limitations: many AND-ed conditions -> very few signals on daily bars (trade-count gate risk)
candle pattern needs TA-Lib (not in the sandbox image; reimplement with pandas)

pipeline_fit.notes: Drop the hammer rule or reimplement; with 4+ ANDed rules some will be dead on daily BTC - a good ablation case.
